text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Um, may I ask just one favor of 
you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I ever feel like I'm about to be 
swallowed up... I want you to call out my 
name.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I have your voice... I'm sure 
I'll be fine, you see."
